info.name: Smart Utility Meter API
info.description:
Express.js + Supabase backend for the ESP32 prepaid energy + water meter.

HOW TO USE
1. Set the collection variables base_url, admin_email and admin_password (Variables tab).
2. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (top to bottom), or send requests one by one in order.
3. Tokens, consumer_id, meter_id, device_key and recharge IDs are saved automatically by the test scripts.

Each run creates a NEW test consumer (random phone) and deletes it in "99 · Cleanup".
Login is rate-limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP: if you get 429, wait or restart the server.
